title: Embedded System Trainee
description: EMBEDDED SYSTEMS TRAINEE Location: Kerala, India Experience: Freshers ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for an Embedded Systems Trainee who is interested in learning and building a career in embedded systems and electronics. Freshers are welcome to apply. This opportunity is suitable for candidates who want to gain practical experience, upskill their technical knowledge, and work on real-time projects. WHAT YOU WILL LEARN & WORK ON Basics of Embedded Systems and Microcontrollers Arduino, ESP32 and other development boards C/C++ programming for embedded systems Sensors and electronic components PCB basics and hardware interfacing Debugging and troubleshooting Real-time embedded projects IoT and connected devices Project development from prototype to working product WHO CAN APPLY Freshers and recent graduates Diploma / B.Tech / B.E. candidates in Electronics, ECE, EEE, CSE, Mechatronics, Robotics or related fields Candidates interested in Embedded Systems and Electronics Candidates looking for an opportunity to learn, upskill and gain practical experience Candidates who are willing to learn new technologies Candidates residing in Kerala SKILLS WE LOOK FOR Basic knowledge of electronics is an advantage Basic programming knowledge is an advantage Interest in hardware and electronics Problem-solving mindset Good learning attitude Willingness to work on practical projects Freshers without prior industry experience are encouraged to apply. WHY JOIN US? Practical, hands-on learning Exposure to real-time projects Opportunity to improve technical skills Learn from experienced trainers and engineers Build industry-ready Embedded Systems skills Opportunity to grow with the organization IMPORTANT Experience is not mandatory. Skills, interest and willingness to learn are more important. If you are a fresher in Kerala looking for an opportunity to start your career in Embedded Systems or upskill your existing knowledge , we encourage you to apply. Pay: ₹5,000.00 - ₹8,000.00 per month Work Location: In person
